name: render-safe
description: Cold-load-safe Dataview accessor and shared gesture lifecycle. customJS.RenderSafe.page(dv) / .filePath(dv) / .fileName(dv) return the live dv.current() page when indexed, else an active-file shim, else null. mutate owns scroll capture, optimistic writes, failure reversion, and bounded reconciliation; mutateStructure carries an opaque optimistic insert/remove receipt into exact rollback without issuing a global Dataview refresh. Enforced by scripts/lint-cold-load.js and the render-safe behavioral harness.
